title: Zesty Velvety Mexican Yeast Sopes
description: A floral and velvety Mexican dish featuring yeast, served in a scallop shell vessel, this recipe is a unique and adventurous take on traditional sopes, with a fodmap-friendly twist.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine yeast, rice flour, khao khuay, fry grind rice, salt, sugar, and zesty mexican seasoning.
Gradually add in water and olive oil, mixing until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape each into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a thin circle, about 1/4 inch thick.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat and cook the sopes for 1-2 minutes on each side, until lightly browned and crispy.
Serve the sopes in scallop shell vessels, garnished with fresh cilantro and a squeeze of lime juice.
Allow the sopes to cool for a few minutes before serving.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
